title: 1RB0RB_1LC1RA_1LF0LD_0LE1LD_1LA1LC_---1LA: the cascade front has no speed law that holds for every stream
text: An exhaustive search over all event streams finds the fewest events that push a disturbance through k cells of the stranded block: 88 for 36 cells, where the measured 3.3 cells per doubling needs about 1,900 (Lean's kernel checks the 88-event stream). A proof of the front speed, and with it a huge no-halt bound, has to use the stream the new zone actually sends. The worst case still grows about 1.2 times per 3 cells, which is not proved for all lengths.
